biography: Born in Milan, Max Papis discovered his passion for racing early, spending countless hours karting on a makeshift track in his family's vineyard. His raw talent was undeniable, catching the attention of a local racing team at the age of 16. His junior career was marked by aggressive overtakes and a fearless approach, earning him the nickname 'Mad Max' among his peers. After winning the Italian Formula Three championship, he made the jump to the Reynard 98i Toyota team, facing immediate pressure to perform. While his debut season showed flashes of brilliance, inconsistent machinery hampered his progress. Now driving for Reynard 2Ki Ford, Max aims to harness his raw talent and calculated approach to establish himself as a true contender.
drivingStyle: Papis is known for his aggressive, late-braking style, often pushing his car to the absolute limit. He possesses exceptional car control, allowing him to recover from near-impossible slides. While undeniably quick, his tire management is still developing, sometimes leading to a significant drop-off in performance towards the end of races. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best results in high-stakes situations, showcasing a cold, calculating demeanor behind the wheel.
